summary: claude-job-hunter is a Node.js (ESM, .mjs) autonomous job-search agent: a set of standalone workers under workers/ plus a Claude Code skill (SKILL.md) that orchestrates them. The one-shot, non-interactive entrypoint is `node workers/apply-now.mjs --text="<job posting text>" [--dry-run]`, which analyzes a posting, writes a tailored cover letter, prints a preview and logs to a SQLite DB (better-sqlite3). All LLM traffic goes through workers/anthropic-client.mjs, which uses bare fetch() with HARDCODED URLs: https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages (model claude-sonnet-4-6, used when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set) with fallbacks to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions (when GROQ_API_KEY is set) and a local Ollama. There is no base-URL env for Anthropic/Groq, so the overlay adds a NODE_OPTIONS --import preload (/opt/harness/proxy-shim.mjs) that wraps globalThis.fetch and rewrites api.anthropic.com to $ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and api.groq.com/openai/v1 to $OPENAI_BASE_URL. With only ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set, every call (callSmart and callFast) hits the proxy's Anthropic /v1/messages endpoint. Each call is also traced to a spans table in the same SQLite file. Verified end-to-end with a mock proxy on debian:bookworm-slim and buildpack-deps:jammy (arm64): two /v1/messages calls, exit 0, agent_log row and spans written, DB + log copied to /out.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=debian:bookworm-slim
FROM ${BASE}
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl xz-utils git && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
ARG NODE_VERSION=22.14.0
RUN set -eux; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) a=x64;; aarch64|arm64) a=arm64;; *) echo "unsupported arch"; exit 1;; esac; \
    mkdir -p /opt/harness/bin; \
    curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-${a}.tar.xz" | tar -xJ -C /opt/harness; \
    mv "/opt/harness/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-${a}" /opt/harness/node; \
    mkdir -p /etc/profile.d; \
    echo 'export PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH' > /etc/profile.d/harness.sh
ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH
COPY . /opt/harness/src
ENV PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=1 PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 npm_config_update_notifier=false npm_config_fund=false npm_config_audit=false
RUN cd /opt/harness/src/workers && npm ci --omit=dev
RUN printf '%s\n' \
  '// Overlay preload: the harness hardcodes api.anthropic.com and api.groq.com; rewrite them to the proxy.' \
  'const A = (process.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL || "").replace(/\/+$/, "");' \
  'const O = (process.env.OPENAI_BASE_URL || "").replace(/\/+$/, "");' \
  'const RULES = [];' \
  'if (A) RULES.push([/^https:\/\/api\.anthropic\.com(?=\/|$)/, A]);' \
  'if (O) RULES.push([/^https:\/\/api\.groq\.com\/openai\/v1(?=\/|$)/, O]);' \
  'if (RULES.length) {' \
  '  const orig = globalThis.fetch;' \
  '  globalThis.fetch = function (input, init) {' \
  '    const url = typeof input === "string" ? input : (input instanceof URL ? input.href : input && input.url);' \
  '    if (typeof url === "string") {' \
  '      let nu = url;' \
  '      for (const [re, to] of RULES) if (re.test(nu)) { nu = nu.replace(re, to); break; }' \
  '      if (nu !== url) input = (typeof input === "string" || input instanceof URL) ? nu : new Request(nu, input);' \
  '    }' \
  '    return orig.call(globalThis, input, init);' \
  '  };' \
  '}' > /opt/harness/proxy-shim.mjs \
  && printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec node /opt/harness/src/workers/apply-now.mjs "$@"\n' > /opt/harness/bin/job-hunter \
  && chmod +x /opt/harness/bin/job-hunter
ENV NODE_OPTIONS=--import=/opt/harness/proxy-shim.mjs
run_command: export PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH; set -o pipefail; mkdir -p /out; node /opt/harness/src/workers/init-db.mjs >/dev/null; node /opt/harness/src/workers/apply-now.mjs --text="$TASK" --dry-run 2>&1 | tee /out/apply-now.log; rc=$?; cp -f /opt/harness/src/workers/applications.db* /out/ 2>/dev/null; exit $rc
check_command: export PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH; node --version && node /opt/harness/src/workers/apply-now.mjs 2>&1 | grep -q "Usage: node apply-now.mjs"
notes:
VERIFIED: overlay built on debian:bookworm-slim and buildpack-deps:jammy (arm64, Docker 29). check_command passes on both. run_command executed end-to-end on both against a mock proxy: apply-now made exactly two POST /v1/messages calls (model=claude-sonnet-4-6, x-api-key=proxy), exited 0, wrote an agent_log dry_run row and two spans, and /out received apply-now.log plus applications.db(+wal/shm).

What $TASK means here: this is a job-application agent, not a coding agent. $TASK is treated as pasted job-posting text (apply-now --text). It does not read or edit files in the task cwd; its outputs are stdout (preview + cover letter) and the SQLite DB. --dry-run is required: without it a 'form' result launches Playwright/Chrome (not installed, needs external network) and an 'email' result tries SMTP/Gmail; dry-run still performs both model calls and logs the result.

Routing: the harness has NO base-URL setting for Anthropic/Groq (only OLLAMA_BASE, which speaks the Ollama /api/chat format the proxy does not). The overlay's fetch-rewriting preload (NODE_OPTIONS --import) maps api.anthropic.com -> ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and api.groq.com/openai/v1 -> OPENAI_BASE_URL. Do NOT set GROQ_API_KEY: with it unset, callFast and callSmart both use the Anthropic path, so the proxy only sees /v1/messages. Model name is hardcoded (claude-sonnet-4-6); no env var chooses it, the proxy substitutes. dotenv loads ./.env from cwd with override:true, so a task dir must not contain a .env that sets ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/GROQ_API_KEY.

DB: init-db.mjs must run first (fresh DB lacks agent_log, otherwise the final logDB call throws). init-db hardcodes workers/applications.db and ignores HUNTDESK_DB_PATH, so the run uses that default file (same one telemetry writes spans to) and copies db+wal+shm to /out afterwards.

Build notes: PATH is re-exported via /etc/profile.d because Debian's /etc/profile resets PATH under bash -lc (jammy does not). npm ci --omit=dev skips promptfoo; native modules (better-sqlite3, sqlite3, keytar) come as prebuilt binaries, no compiler or python needed. PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD/PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD prevent browser downloads. Optional profile env (FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, EMAIL, PROFILE_TEXT, CV_PATH) can be added to make the cover letter meaningful; defaults are used otherwise. A convenience wrapper /opt/harness/bin/job-hunter forwards to apply-now.mjs.
